# Standstill UK Tenders

> UK public sector tenders open now, searchable by closing date, region, CPV code, buyer and value. Free, updated daily from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Data pages (rebuilt daily)
- [How to Bid for UK Public Sector Tenders: 6 Steps for Small Businesses](https://standstill.uk/how-to-bid/): How small businesses bid for UK public sector tenders: free supplier registration, CPV codes, selection questionnaires, social value and closing dates.
- [UK Tenders Closing Soon (Oct 2026): Bids Due in the Next 14 Days](https://standstill.uk/closing-soon/): Open UK public sector tenders closing in the next 14 days, soonest first. Free, updated daily from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder (2026-10-28).
- [UK Tenders for Small Businesses (Oct 2026): SME-Friendly Open Contracts](https://standstill.uk/sme-friendly/): 1079 open UK public sector tenders that buyers marked as suitable for SMEs, sorted by closing date. Updated daily (2026-10-28).
- [UK Tenders for Charities (Oct 2026): VCSE-Friendly Open Contracts](https://standstill.uk/vcse-friendly/): 471 open UK public sector tenders marked as suitable for voluntary, community and social enterprises (VCSEs). Updated daily (2026-10-28).
- [UK Public Sector Tenders by Region](https://standstill.uk/region/): Open UK public sector tenders by region: London, the South East, the North West, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland and more.
- [UK Tenders by CPV Category](https://standstill.uk/cpv/): Open UK public sector tenders grouped by CPV category: construction work, IT services, health and social work, cleaning, transport and more.
- [UK Public Sector Buyers with Open Tenders](https://standstill.uk/buyer/): UK public sector buyers with the most open tenders: councils, NHS trusts, universities, housing associations and central government.
- [UK Tenders by Contract Value](https://standstill.uk/value/): Open UK public sector tenders grouped by estimated contract value, from under £25,000 to over £10 million.
- [New UK Public Sector Tenders This Week by Sector](https://standstill.uk/new/): UK public sector tenders published in the last 7 days, grouped by sector: construction, engineering, health and social care, IT and more.
- [Weekly stats: UK public sector tenders](https://standstill.uk/stats/): As of Oct 28, 2026, our daily copy of Find a Tender and Contracts Finder (UK government) lists 1,647 open tenders. 376 close within 7 days and 378 wer
- [Free downloads: deadline calendar, CSV and embed](https://standstill.uk/data/): Free downloads of open UK public sector tenders deadlines: subscribe to an .ics calendar, get a daily CSV, or embed the next 10 deadlines on your site. Sou

## About the data
- Source: [Find a Tender and Contracts Finder (UK government)](https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/)
- Licence: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0
- Last data refresh: 2026-10-28
- Updated once a day from the official public data. Unofficial; always confirm details on the official notice before applying or bidding.

## Guides
- [Dynamic Markets Procurement Act 2023: 6 SME Steps](https://standstill.uk/dynamic-markets-procurement-act-2023-6-sme-steps/): Dynamic markets under the Procurement Act 2023 replaced the DPS. See how SMEs and charities find UK13 notices, meet membership conditions and join in 6 steps.
- [Tender No Bid Response: 5 UK Steps and a Wording Template](https://standstill.uk/tender-no-bid-response-5-uk-steps-and-a-wording-template/): Tender no bid response guide for UK SMEs: how to decline on Atamis or Jaggaer, what to write, framework rules, and when saying no protects future bids.
- [Competitive Flexible Procedure: 6 SME Steps (2026)](https://standstill.uk/competitive-flexible-procedure-6-sme-steps-2026/): How the competitive flexible procedure works under the Procurement Act 2023: stages, minimum timescales, supplier limits and a 6-step SME bid checklist.
- [Tender Writing Examples: 5 UK SME Answer Templates 2026](https://standstill.uk/tender-writing-examples-5-uk-sme-answer-templates-2026/): Tender writing examples for UK SMEs: 5 annotated quality, price and social value answers mapped to scoring criteria, with steps, costs and common mistakes.
- [Cyber Essentials Public Sector Tender: 5 Steps and Costs](https://standstill.uk/cyber-essentials-public-sector-tender-5-steps-and-costs/): Cyber Essentials for a public sector tender: which contracts need it under PPN 014, costs from £320 + VAT, timelines, and how to evidence it in your SQ.
- [Procurement Act 2023 Thresholds: 2026 Table and 5 SME Steps](https://standstill.uk/procurement-act-2023-thresholds-2026-table-and-5-sme-steps/): Procurement Act 2023 thresholds from 1 January 2026 in one table, plus a 5-step SME checklist to see which notices, timescales and rules apply.
- [CPV Codes UK: 5 Steps to Pick Codes and Set Alerts 2026](https://standstill.uk/cpv-codes-uk-5-steps-to-pick-codes-and-set-alerts-2026/): CPV codes UK guide for SMEs: how the 8-digit code works, how to shortlist 3-5 codes, and how to set email alerts on Find a Tender and Contracts Finder.
- [Most Advantageous Tender: 5 Steps and a Scoring Example](https://standstill.uk/most-advantageous-tender-5-steps-and-a-scoring-example/): Most advantageous tender (MAT) explained for UK SMEs: how it differs from MEAT under the Procurement Act 2023, a worked scoring example and 5 bid steps.
- [Dynamic Purchasing System: 6 SME Steps for 2026](https://standstill.uk/dynamic-purchasing-system-6-sme-steps-for-2026/): Dynamic purchasing system rules changed: how UK SMEs join a dynamic market or legacy DPS, stay a member and bid, with 2026 thresholds and 2029 cut-off.
- [Find a Tender Registration: 5 Steps for UK Suppliers 2026](https://standstill.uk/find-a-tender-registration-5-steps-for-uk-suppliers-2026/): Find a Tender registration for UK suppliers in 5 steps: GOV.UK One Login, organisation details, PPON, and how it differs from a Companies House number.
- [UK Public Procurement: Contracts Finder vs Find a Tender](https://standstill.uk/contracts-finder-vs-find-a-tender-2026-table-and-steps/): UK public procurement guide comparing Contracts Finder and Find a Tender: the £12,000/£30,000 and £135,018 thresholds explained, plus step-by-step SME registration instructions.
- [How to Win Government Contracts UK: 7 Steps for SMEs (2026)](https://standstill.uk/how-to-win-government-contracts-uk-7-steps-for-smes-2026/): How to win government contracts in the UK without paid tools: 7 steps using Find a Tender, CPV codes and Contracts Finder, with 2026 thresholds for SMEs.
- [Framework Agreement How to Get On: 6 SME Steps (2026)](https://standstill.uk/framework-agreement-how-to-get-on-6-sme-steps-2026/): Framework agreement how to get on: 6 steps from Find a Tender registration to call-off wins, plus how open frameworks and dynamic markets reopen for SMEs.
- [Social Value in Tenders: PPN 002 Steps and Answer Examples](https://standstill.uk/social-value-in-tenders-ppn-002-steps-and-answer-examples/): Social value in tenders explained for SMEs: PPN 002's 8 outcomes, the 10% minimum weighting, step-by-step answers and worked examples you can adapt.
- [Selection Questionnaire Procurement Act 2023: 7 SME Steps](https://standstill.uk/selection-questionnaire-procurement-act-2023-7-sme-steps/): Selection questionnaire Procurement Act 2023 guide for SMEs: what replaced the SQ, the exclusion and participation rules, and 7 steps to answer the PSQ.
